# SkyWalk Holidays

> Nepal's premier travel agency and tour operator based in Kathmandu, specializing in all-inclusive international holiday packages, flight ticketing, hotel reservations, and visa assistance.

## Core Travel Services
- [International Holiday Packages](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/packages/international): Tailored and fixed group departure packages to Thailand (Bangkok, Pattaya, Phuket), Bali Indonesia, Vietnam (Hanoi, Ha Long Bay), China (Beijing, Shanghai, Great Wall), Singapore, Malaysia, and Maldives.
- [Domestic Tours & Nepal Treks](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/packages/domestic): Curated travel packages across Nepal including Pokhara, Chitwan National Park safari, and Everest mountain flights.
- [Air Flight Ticketing](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/flights): Domestic and international air ticket bookings comparing unpublished airline partner fares across 40+ carriers.
- [Hotel Reservations](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/hotels): Luxury resorts, villas, and boutique budget stays with verified amenities and instant confirmation.
- [Visa Assistance](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/visa): Full documentation guidance, embassy appointment scheduling, and application tracking for tourist, business, and transit visas.
- [Custom Tour Planning](https://skywalkholiday.com/services/custom): Bespoke holiday itinerary building for families, honeymooners, and corporate groups.

## Top International Destinations
- [Thailand Tour Packages](https://skywalkholiday.com/destinations/thailand): Bangkok city, Grand Palace, Pattaya Coral Island, and Phuket beaches. Starting at NPR 42,000.
- [Bali Tour Packages](https://skywalkholiday.com/destinations/bali): Ubud pool villas, Nusa Penida Kelingking beach, and Tanah Lot sunsets. Starting at NPR 78,000.
- [Vietnam Tour Packages](https://skywalkholiday.com/destinations/vietnam): Hanoi historical quarters, Ha Long Bay overnight cruises, and Da Nang golden bridge.
- [China Tour Packages](https://skywalkholiday.com/destinations/china): Beijing Forbidden City, Great Wall at Mutianyu, bullet trains, and Shanghai Bund.
